description: Request a custom research report from BCA Research. Required: contact_email and topic (4 to 256 characters). Free to submit; needs an API key (the free tier is enough). Each request alerts BCA Research, who reply to contact_email by hand with scope and a quote; payment is by Stripe invoice. Returns request_id, status and next_step.

contact_email.description: Required. Where BCA Research sends the scope and quote.

deadline.description: Optional deadline: an ISO date or free text such as 'within 2 weeks' (up to 40 characters).

depth.description: Report depth: light, standard or deep.

notes.description: Optional notes for the research team (up to 4,000 characters).

target_wordcount.description: Target report length in words, 500 to 20,000.

topic.description: Required. What to research (4 to 256 characters).

name: request_custom_research
